purpose: Apply targeted architecture refinements identified by external research before additional executable parent runtime is implemented, while preserving qualified foundations and preventing duplicate capability creation.

implementation_pause.reason: The contract must be rechecked against research-verified editorial, consistency, publication and provenance boundaries before code is added.

preserve_without_rebuild: Literary Prose A-L / Prose Project architecture

professional_editorial_stages.rule: Crosswalk existing capabilities first. These tokens define parent-visible responsibilities and gates, not four new projects or four replacement engines.
professional_editorial_stages.prior_stage_regression_rule: Every later editorial stage must verify required prior-stage edits were applied and did not introduce new defects.
professional_editorial_stages.proof_rule: Proofreading is target-medium/final-layout verification and cannot silently reopen structural editing without explicit authorization.

publication_profile.rule: PDF, DOCX, print and EPUB are separate target-medium verification profiles; no format inherits another format's assumptions.

research_before_implementation_rule.exception: Strict repair of already-qualified behavior where no architecture/capability expansion occurs.
research_before_implementation_rule.rule: External popularity, one vendor, one model, or one source is never sufficient authority by itself.

must_not_do: rebuild Creative Excellence or Prose from first principles
create a new universal prose scalar
grant a single LLM judge final authority
allow evaluator/provider output to mutate canon directly
replace internal version/provenance authority with an external interchange standard
treat copy editing or proofreading as unrestricted developmental rewriting
qualification_effect: NONE. This is architecture/control remediation only. Existing exact-SHA A-01 evidence remains bounded to its original tested subjects.
